_README: Task -> reasoning-type mapping. EDIT THIS FILE to change any assignment; the
scripts read it and never hard-code a category.
logicbench is NOT listed here: its family is parsed mechanically from the task
which is unambiguous and cannot drift.
logiglue has no machine-readable category in the task YAMLs, so it is mapped by
hand below from the LogiGLUE benchmark's own taxonomy. Entries marked
confidence 'review' are the ones to check against the paper before publishing --
the scripts print them as a warning on every run.
'mixed' = general multi-type logical-reasoning sets (exam-style MCQ, NLI) that
the deductive/inductive/abductive split does not cleanly describe. Keeping them
in their own bucket is deliberate: forcing them into one of the three would
invent a claim the benchmark does not make.

logiglue_alpha_nli.note: alphaNLI / ART -- the only abductive set, so this group is a single task

logiglue_anli.note: Adversarial NLI -- NOT abductive; do not confuse with alpha_nli

logiglue_birdelectricity.note: defeasible / non-monotonic; not cleanly one of the three
